apple-calpal 1.0.0

- Initial release of "Apple Calendar Pal" — a personal schedule assistant focused on seamless integration with iPhone calendars.
- Supports importing structured schedules (like class timetables, work shifts, exam dates) into protected commitment calendars.
- Enables natural language planning: finds free time, checks weather/sunset, calculates when to leave, and writes events directly to Apple (iCloud) Calendar.
- Distinguishes between fixed commitments and ad-hoc plans, with separate handling and calendar storage for each.
- Provides robust confirmation before making any changes, detailed handling of reminders, and safeguards against accidental deletions.
- All functionality is implemented via standard-library Python scripts, requiring zero external dependencies.
